standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same unit, chapter notation for a^* on modules

core_obligations: Statement (lines 4691-4701): for a site C with equalizers and fibre products, a sheaf of rings O_C, and a hypercovering K, the functor a^*: Mod(O_C) -> Mod(O) is fully faithful with essential image the cartesian O-modules, and a_* provides the quasi-inverse.

Pullback simplification (proof lines 4703-4705): since a^{-1}O_C = O by construction of the structure sheaf on the total simplicial site, the tensor in a^*F = a^{-1}F tensor_{a^{-1}O_C} O is over O itself, whence a^* = a^{-1} as functors.

Reduction (lines 4705-4707): the lemma is the module-level restatement of Lemma lemma-hypercovering-descent-sheaves, whose fully-faithful, essential-image and quasi-inverse conclusions transfer verbatim under the identification a^* = a^{-1}.
proof_roadmap: Identify a^{-1}O_C = O so the module pullback loses its tensor factor.
Conclude a^* equals a^{-1} and invoke the sheaf-level descent lemma.
Read off full faithfulness, essential image, and the quasi-inverse a_*.
